about:
American Sewing Workroom, LLC (ASW) operates as a family-owned contract sewing and product development shop in Roswell, Georgia, within the metro Atlanta area. The company does not disclose its founding year, but its chief executive is a professional tailor with extensive fashion-industry experience who can translate spontaneous ideas into patterns.

ASW provides a full spectrum of garment production services, including pattern making, grading, prototyping, cutting, sewing, and embroidery. The workroom positions itself as a one-stop resource for both established apparel lines and entrepreneurs entering the garment industry, handling each phase from concept through finished goods. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The client base consists primarily of women's and children's fashion designers, both local and out-of-state. ASW works with designers who need development support as well as those ready for production runs, though minimum order quantities and typical lead times are not specified.

The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing, stating it is proud to make products in the U.S. where "quality matters." It differentiates itself through the CEO's pattern-making expertise, a team of skilled technicians and product-development specialists, and attention to detail described as unparalleled in the industry.
